title: Early Prediction of Satellite Collision Probability Using a Hybrid TCN-Transformer Model for a CDM-Based Conjunction Analysis Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.13191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid expansion of operational satellites and orbital debris has increased the frequency of close approach events in low Earth orbit (LEO), creating a higher operational burden for satellite operators. This problem is especially critical for satellites using electric propulsion, where low-thrust maneuver capability imposes additional time constraints on collision avoidance planning. In current practice, Conjunction Data Messages (CDMs) provide relative state, covariance, miss distance, time of closest approach, and probability of collision (PoC) information for conjunction assessment. However, the nonlinear propagation of orbital uncertainties and the sensitivity of PoC to covariance evolution make the interpretation of sequential CDMs challenging. translated_title: 基于CDM交会分析框架的混合TCN-Transformer模型卫星碰撞概率早期预测
translated_abstract: 在轨卫星和轨道碎片的快速增长增加了近地轨道（LEO）中近距离交会事件的发生频率，给卫星运营商带来了更高的运营负担。这一问题对于使用电推进系统的卫星尤为关键，因为低推力机动能力对避撞规划施加了额外的时间约束。在目前的实践中，交会数据消息（CDM）为交会评估提供相对状态、协方差、近距离距离、最近接近时刻和碰撞概率（PoC）等信息。然而，轨道不确定性的非线性传播以及PoC对协方差演化的敏感性，使得对连续CDM序列的解读颇具挑战性。本研究提出了一种基于学习的卫星交会风险早期预测框架，通过估计同一近距离交会事件后续CDM更新中预期的PoC来实现早期风险预测。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于CDM序列数据的混合TCN-Transformer学习框架，能够对卫星交会事件的碰撞概率进行早期预测，从而为电推进卫星的避撞机动规划争取宝贵时间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid TCN-Transformer learning framework that enables early prediction of satellite collision probability from sequential CDM data, providing critical lead time for collision avoidance maneuver planning, especially for electric propulsion satellites.
